metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the morning rehearsal, a thin Richard the Third, Corpus Christi still printed, Long Meg as a title, and the talk of a duke at the window.

yesterday: The two hired men had slept in the house. The chain was off the gate for the rehearsal and the plot's title was turned away.
The almanac still prints Corpus Christi, for leases and reckonings.
The Rose's title was Long Meg.
At the window: the play was thin, and you were a duke in it. It was Richard the Third. Your father tells the waggons and Herod as a fair he was at.
